atoms.name: mod
atoms.rule: a % b is the remainder a - b * (a / b), with the sign of a (-7 % 2 = -1); b = 0 gives NaN.
atoms.plain: a % b is the remainder a - b * (a / b), with the sign of a (-7 % 2 = -1); b = 0 gives NaN.

atoms.name: neg
atoms.rule: - a is the negation of a.
atoms.plain: - a is the negation of a.

atoms.name: grid_rotate
atoms.rule: a v1_u21BB_ rotates grid a clockwise by 90 degrees.
atoms.plain: a v1_u21BB_ rotates grid a clockwise by 90 degrees.

atoms.name: grid_reflect_h
atoms.rule: a v1_u21CB_ reverses the columns of grid a.
atoms.plain: a v1_u21CB_ reverses the columns of grid a.

atoms.name: grid_reflect_v
atoms.rule: a v1_u2195_ reverses the rows of grid a.
atoms.plain: a v1_u2195_ reverses the rows of grid a.

atoms.name: grid_transpose
atoms.rule: a v1_u2922_ exchanges rows and columns of grid a.
atoms.plain: a v1_u2922_ exchanges rows and columns of grid a.

atoms.name: grid_wrap_right
atoms.rule: a ⇝ b moves grid a right by b columns, wrapping at the edge.
atoms.plain: a ⇝ b moves grid a right by b columns, wrapping at the edge.

atoms.name: grid_wrap_down
atoms.rule: a v1_u21DF_ b moves grid a down by b rows, wrapping at the edge.
atoms.plain: a v1_u21DF_ b moves grid a down by b rows, wrapping at the edge.

atoms.name: grid_shift_right
atoms.rule: a v1_u21E2_ b moves grid a right by b columns and fills exposed cells with 0.
atoms.plain: a v1_u21E2_ b moves grid a right by b columns and fills exposed cells with 0.

atoms.name: grid_shift_down
atoms.rule: a v1_u21E3_ b moves grid a down by b rows and fills exposed cells with 0.
atoms.plain: a v1_u21E3_ b moves grid a down by b rows and fills exposed cells with 0.

atoms.name: grid_recolour
atoms.rule: a ♧ b replaces colour b / 10 rounded down with colour b % 10 in grid a; b outside 0 to 99 gives NaN.
atoms.plain: a ♧ b replaces colour b / 10 rounded down with colour b % 10 in grid a; b outside 0 to 99 gives NaN.

atoms.name: grid_overlay
atoms.rule: a v1_u25A3_ b places nonzero cells of b over a; unequal shapes give NaN.
atoms.plain: a v1_u25A3_ b places nonzero cells of b over a; unequal shapes give NaN.

atoms.name: grid_crop
atoms.rule: a v1_u2317_ crops to the smallest box containing nonzero cells; an all-zero grid gives [[0]].
atoms.plain: a v1_u2317_ crops to the smallest box containing nonzero cells; an all-zero grid gives [[0]].

atoms.name: grid_count
atoms.rule: a v1_u2116_ b counts cells of colour b in grid a; b outside 0 to 9 gives NaN.
atoms.plain: a v1_u2116_ b counts cells of colour b in grid a; b outside 0 to 9 gives NaN.

atoms.name: grid_fill
atoms.rule: a v1_u25A7_ b replaces zero cells of grid a with colour b; b outside 0 to 9 gives NaN.
atoms.plain: a v1_u25A7_ b replaces zero cells of grid a with colour b; b outside 0 to 9 gives NaN.

atoms.name: grid_equal
atoms.rule: a v1_u2263_ b is true exactly when both grids have the same shape and colours.
atoms.plain: a v1_u2263_ b is true exactly when both grids have the same shape and colours.

domain.en: A value is a grid of 1 to 10 rows and columns with colours 0 to 9; 0 is the background.
Integers give shifts, colours, colour codes and recursive counts.

settings.en: Any rectangle up to 10 by 10 is a value.
Ten colours in the ARC palette; 0 is the empty background.
A recursive call repeats its grid step at most this many times; larger counts give NaN.

why.en: These atoms are one example. Atoms are chosen by the user: any function with a rule can be registered and the same three composition forms grow operators from it.

operators.name: f1
operators.definition: a f1 b = { (a v1_u21DF_ b) f9 0 }
operators.plain: Wrap a down by b rows, then apply f9 to the result and 0.

operators.name: f2
operators.plain: If a equals the 2×3 grid 303/010, wrap a down by b rows, then apply f13 to the result; otherwise wrap a down by b rows.

operators.name: f3
operators.definition: a f3 b = { a, if b == 0; (a f3 (b - 1)) f32, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a f3 (b + 1)) f32, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply f32 to the current value.

operators.name: f4
operators.plain: Apply f7 to a, then shift it right by 1 column, filling with 0.

operators.name: f5
operators.plain: Mirror a left to right, then apply f14 to the result and 0.

operators.name: f6
operators.plain: Wrap a right by b columns, then shift it right by 0 columns, filling with 0.

operators.name: f7
operators.plain: Crop a to the smallest rectangle that holds all its nonzero cells, then flip it upside down.

operators.name: f8
operators.plain: Wrap a right by b columns, then recolour the colour 0 cells in the result to colour 2.

operators.name: f9
operators.definition: a f9 b = { (a f8 b) f7 }
operators.plain: Apply f8 to a and b, then apply f7 to the result.

operators.name: f10
operators.plain: Rotate a 90 degrees clockwise, then wrap it right by 3 columns.

operators.name: f11
operators.plain: Shift a down by b rows, filling with 0, then shift it right by 4 columns, filling with 0.

operators.name: f12
operators.plain: Use the number of colour b cells in a as a two digit code to recolour the 2×3 grid 303/010.

operators.name: f13
operators.plain: Apply f10 to a, then apply f1 to the result and 4.

operators.name: f14
operators.plain: Apply f12 to the 2×3 grid 303/010 and (the number of colour b cells in a).

operators.name: f15
operators.plain: Lay the nonzero cells of b over a, then apply f14 to the result and 3.

operators.name: f16
operators.plain: Apply f7 to a, then apply f15 to the result and the 2×2 grid 00/00.

operators.name: f17
operators.plain: Apply f15 to the 2×2 grid 01/20 and (a shifted down by b rows).

operators.name: f18
operators.plain: Lay the nonzero cells of b over a, then apply f8 to the result and 1.

operators.name: f19
operators.plain: Shift a down by b rows, filling with 0, then apply f13 to the result.

operators.name: f20
operators.plain: If a equals the 2×3 grid 303/010, mirror a left to right, then apply f1 to the result and 3; otherwise mirror a left to right.

operators.name: f21
operators.plain: If a equals the 2×2 grid 00/00, lay the nonzero cells of b over a, then apply f13 to the result; otherwise lay the nonzero cells of b over a.

operators.name: f22
operators.plain: If a equals the 2×3 grid 303/010, apply f15 to the 2×2 grid 01/20 and (a flipped upside down); otherwise flip a upside down.

operators.name: f23
operators.plain: If a equals the 2×3 grid 303/010, count the cells of colour b in a, then take the remainder when dividing it by 0; otherwise count the cells of colour b in a.

operators.name: f24
operators.plain: If a equals the 2×3 grid 303/010, shift a right by b columns, filling with 0, then apply f16 to the result; otherwise shift a right by b columns, filling with 0.

operators.name: f25
operators.plain: If a equals the 2×3 grid 303/010, use b as a two digit code to recolour a, then apply f1 to the result and 2; otherwise use b as a two digit code to recolour a.

operators.name: f26
operators.plain: If a equals the 2×3 grid 303/010, rotate a 90 degrees clockwise, then apply f22 to the result; otherwise rotate a 90 degrees clockwise.

operators.name: f27
operators.plain: If a equals the 2×2 grid 00/00, crop a to the smallest rectangle that holds all its nonzero cells, then apply f20 to the result; otherwise crop a to the smallest rectangle that holds all its nonzero cells.

operators.name: f28
operators.plain: If a equals the 2×3 grid 303/010, fill the empty cells of a with colour b, then apply f2 to the result and 3; otherwise fill the empty cells of a with colour b.

operators.name: f29
operators.plain: If a equals the 2×2 grid 00/00, transpose a, then apply f28 to the result and 2; otherwise transpose a.

operators.name: f30
operators.plain: If a equals the 2×3 grid 303/010, shift a down by b rows, filling with 0, then apply f16 to the result; otherwise shift a down by b rows, filling with 0.

operators.name: f31
operators.plain: If a equals the 2×2 grid 01/20, apply f18 to a and b, then apply f26 to the result; otherwise compute a f18 b.

operators.name: f32
operators.plain: Transpose a, then apply f2 to the result and 4.

operators.name: f33
operators.plain: Apply f24 to a and b, then apply f27 to the result.

operators.name: f34
operators.definition: a f34 b = { (a f8 b) f4 }
operators.plain: Apply f8 to a and b, then apply f4 to the result.

operators.name: f35
operators.plain: If a equals the 2×3 grid 303/010, apply f4 to a, then apply f21 to the result and the 2×2 grid 01/20; otherwise apply f4 to a.

operators.name: f36
operators.plain: If a equals the 2×3 grid 303/010, flip a upside down, then apply f9 to the result and 1; otherwise flip a upside down.

operators.name: f37
operators.plain: Apply f31 to the 2×2 grid 00/00 and (a f27).

operators.name: f38
operators.plain: If a equals the 2×3 grid 303/010, subtract a f23 b from 1; otherwise compute a f23 b.

operators.name: f39
operators.plain: If a equals the 2×2 grid 01/20, flip a upside down, then apply f8 to the result and 1; otherwise flip a upside down.

operators.name: f40
operators.plain: If a equals the 2×3 grid 303/010, apply f8 to a and b, then apply f24 to the result and 3; otherwise compute a f8 b.

operators.name: f41
operators.plain: Apply f28 to a and b, then apply f34 to the result and 4.

operators.name: f42
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply f26 to the current value.

operators.name: f43
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply f29 to the current value.

operators.name: f44
operators.definition: a f44 b = { a, if b == 0; (a f44 (b - 1)) v1_u21CB_, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a f44 (b + 1)) v1_u21CB_, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a; repeat |b| times: mirror the current value left to right (counts beyond the bound give NaN).

operators.name: f45
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply f10 to the current value.

operators.name: f46
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): crop the current value to the smallest rectangle that holds all its nonzero cells.

operators.name: f47
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply f39 to the current value.

operators.name: f48
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply f35 to the current value.

operators.name: f49
operators.definition: a f49 b = { a, if b == 0; (a f49 (b - 1)) f5, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a f49 (b + 1)) f5, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply f5 to the current value.

operators.name: f50
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply f16 to the current value.

operators.name: f51
operators.plain: Apply f23 to (a f49 b) and 3.

operators.name: f52
operators.plain: Apply f48 to a and b, then apply f10 to the result.

operators.name: f53
operators.plain: Subtract a f51 b from 4.

operators.name: f54
operators.plain: Apply f51 to a and b, then add 2 to it.

operators.name: f55
operators.plain: Apply f52 to a and b, then apply f8 to the result and 4.

operators.name: f56
operators.plain: Apply f3 to a and b, then apply f31 to the result and the 2×2 grid 00/00.

operators.name: f57
operators.plain: Apply f50 to a and b, then apply f16 to the result.

operators.name: f58
operators.plain: Apply f47 to a and b, then apply f12 to the result and 3.

operators.name: f59
operators.plain: Apply f53 to (a f3 b) and 2.

operators.name: f60
operators.plain: Apply f18 to the 2×2 grid 00/00 and (a f47 b).

operators.name: f61
operators.definition: a f61 b = { (a f43 b) f5 }
operators.plain: Apply f43 to a and b, then apply f5 to the result.

operators.name: f62
operators.definition: a f62 b = { (a f3 b) f39 }
operators.plain: Apply f3 to a and b, then apply f39 to the result.

operators.name: f63
operators.plain: Apply f38 to (a f55 b) and 4.

operators.name: f64
operators.plain: Lay the nonzero cells of a f43 b over the 2×2 grid 01/20.

operators.name: f65
operators.plain: Use a f51 b as a two digit code to recolour the 2×2 grid 00/00.

operators.name: f66
operators.plain: If a equals the 2×2 grid 01/20, subtract a f63 b from 0; otherwise compute a f63 b.

operators.name: f67
operators.plain: If a equals the 2×2 grid 00/00, apply f50 to a and b, then flip it upside down; otherwise compute a f50 b.

operators.name: f68
operators.plain: If a equals the 2×2 grid 01/20, count the cells of colour a f51 b in the 2×2 grid 01/20; otherwise compute a f51 b.

operators.name: f69
operators.plain: If a equals the 2×3 grid 303/010, apply f31 to the 2×2 grid 01/20 and (a f52 b); otherwise compute a f52 b.

operators.name: f70
operators.plain: If a equals the 2×2 grid 01/20, apply f68 to a and b, then apply f23 to the 2×2 grid 00/00 and the result; otherwise compute a f68 b.

operators.name: f71
operators.plain: If a equals the 2×2 grid 00/00, subtract a f63 b from 2; otherwise compute a f63 b.

operators.name: f72
operators.plain: If a equals the 2×2 grid 01/20, apply f42 to a and b, then apply f6 to the result and 2; otherwise compute a f42 b.

operators.name: f73
operators.plain: If a equals the 2×2 grid 01/20, apply f50 to a and b, then apply f55 to the result and 3; otherwise compute a f50 b.

operators.name: f74
operators.plain: If a equals the 2×2 grid 00/00, apply f63 to a and b, then apply f54 to the 2×2 grid 00/00 and the result; otherwise compute a f63 b.

operators.name: f75
operators.plain: If a equals the 2×3 grid 303/010, apply f68 to a and b, then apply f23 to the 2×2 grid 01/20 and the result; otherwise compute a f68 b.

operators.name: f76
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply f58 to the current value and 1.

operators.name: f77
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply f56 to the current value and 1.

operators.name: f78
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply f62 to the current value and 1.

operators.name: f79
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply f60 to the current value and 1.

operators.name: f80
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply f52 to the current value and 1.

operators.name: f81
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply f55 to the current value and 1.

operators.name: f82
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -8 to 8; other values give NaN): apply f65 to the current value and 1.

operators.name: f83
operators.plain: Apply f59 to (a f80 b) and 3.

operators.name: f84
operators.plain: Apply f82 to a and b, then apply f35 to the result.

operators.name: f85
operators.plain: Apply f82 to a and b, then apply f2 to the result and 2.

operators.name: f86
operators.definition: a f86 b = { (a f82 b) f5 }
operators.plain: Apply f82 to a and b, then apply f5 to the result.

operators.name: f87
operators.plain: Apply f79 to a and b, then apply f29 to the result.

operators.name: f88
operators.plain: Apply f84 to a and b, then apply f24 to the result and 1.

operators.name: f89
operators.plain: Apply f78 to a and b, then apply f28 to the result and 4.

operators.name: f90
operators.plain: Apply f82 to a and b, then apply f58 to the result and 1.

operators.name: f91
operators.plain: Apply f66 to (a f76 b) and 1.

operators.name: f92
operators.plain: Apply f89 to a and b, then apply f29 to the result.

operators.name: f93
operators.plain: Apply f82 to a and b, then apply f37 to the result.

operators.name: f94
operators.plain: If a equals the 2×2 grid 00/00, apply f85 to a and b, then apply f6 to the result and 1; otherwise compute a f85 b.

operators.name: f95
operators.plain: If a equals the 2×3 grid 303/010, apply f82 to a and b, then apply f39 to the result; otherwise compute a f82 b.

operators.name: f96
operators.plain: If a equals the 2×2 grid 00/00, apply f94 to a and b, then apply f31 to the result and the 2×2 grid 00/00; otherwise compute a f94 b.

operators.name: f97
operators.plain: If a equals the 2×2 grid 01/20, apply f86 to a and b, then apply f92 to the result and 2; otherwise compute a f86 b.

operators.name: f98
operators.plain: If a equals the 2×2 grid 01/20, apply f81 to a and b, then apply f69 to the result and 1; otherwise compute a f81 b.

operators.name: f99
operators.plain: If a equals the 2×2 grid 01/20, apply f84 to a and b, then apply f61 to the result and 0; otherwise compute a f84 b.

operators.name: f100
operators.plain: If a equals the 2×3 grid 303/010, apply f87 to a and b, then transpose it; otherwise compute a f87 b.
